seo.title: Onboarding — Jobsite Systems
seo.description: A guided onboarding walkthrough for new Jobsite Systems clients. Tell us about your business so we can build your site right.

header.heading: Let's build your site.
header.lead: Fourteen short questions about your business — most folks finish in 10–15 minutes. Skip what you don't have, ramble in the open boxes, drop a phone number for anything you'd rather walk through. We'll turn this into a real first draft and follow up within one business day.

form.subject: New onboarding intake from jobsite.systems
form.successMessage: Got everything. We'll review and follow up within one business day with a real response.
form.errorMessage: Something went wrong. Please try again or email us directly at hello@jobsite.systems.

steps.title: What kind of trade business do you have?
steps.description: Pick all that apply. A mix is normal — many trade businesses wear several hats.

options.label: Handyman / general repairs
options.description: Punch lists, small jobs, multi-trade fixes.

options.label: HVAC
options.description: Install, repair, maintenance — residential or light commercial.

options.label: Plumbing
options.description: Service calls, repipes, water heaters, fixtures.

options.label: Electrical
options.description: Service work, panel upgrades, lighting, EV chargers.

options.label: Carpentry / finish work
options.description: Trim, built-ins, decks, framing, doors.

options.label: Remodeling
options.description: Kitchens, baths, additions, whole-house remodels.

options.label: General contractor
options.description: Multi-trade GC, new builds or major renovations.

options.label: Other
options.description: Tell us in step 12.

steps.title: Tell me about your business.
steps.description: The basics — name, history, structure, and what makes you different from the next outfit on the directory page.

fields.name: company_name
fields.label: Business Name
fields.placeholder: Your Business, LLC

options.label: Solo operator
options.description: One-person handyman, HVAC tech, plumber, or specialist.

options.label: Multi-crew shop (I own it)
options.description: A few crews, I'm the owner / operator.

options.label: Multi-crew shop (I work in the field)
options.description: I'm a lead or foreman but don't own the business.

options.label: Larger contractor / multi-site GC
options.description: Bigger entity with multiple locations or service lines.

options.label: Something else
options.description: Tell us in the box below.

fields.name: differentiation
fields.label: What makes your business different?
fields.placeholder: A sentence or two — years of experience, manufacturer certifications, specific specialties, same-day service, warranty terms, whatever sets you apart.

steps.title: Where do you work?
steps.description: Your home base, towns and ZIPs you cover, drive-time radius — whatever shape your service area takes.

fields.name: home_base
fields.label: Primary location
fields.placeholder: Denver, CO

fields.name: service_area
fields.label: Service area — towns, ZIPs, drive-time radius, or counties covered
fields.placeholder: e.g. Denver Metro plus Aurora, Lakewood, Arvada, Wheat Ridge, Englewood. Up to ~30 miles from downtown. Adams, Arapahoe, Denver, Jefferson counties.

steps.title: Who do you work for?
steps.description: Pick everything you actually take — even if homeowners are most of the work, the others still belong on the site if you take that work.

options.label: Homeowners
options.description: Single-family residential.

options.label: Property managers
options.description: Multi-unit, rental portfolios, HOAs.

options.label: Commercial / light commercial
options.description: Offices, restaurants, retail, small commercial buildings.

options.label: Builders / GCs
options.description: Sub work for other contractors.

options.label: Real estate / flippers
options.description: Pre-listing repairs, flip rehabs, inspection punch lists.

options.label: Insurance restoration
options.description: Storm, water, fire damage repairs paid by insurance.

options.label: Specific niche
options.description: Historic homes, luxury, smart-home installs, accessibility, etc.

options.label: Other
options.description: Tell us in step 12.

steps.title: What do you focus on?
steps.description: Short names are fine. We'll turn this into the services / trades pages on your site. Pricing notes are optional — only fill them in if you want a price on the site.

fields.name: services_list
fields.label: Services and trades
fields.placeholder: Furnace repair, AC install, water heater swap, drain cleaning, panel upgrades, kitchen remodels, deck builds, finish carpentry, emergency service…

fields.name: pricing_model
fields.label: Pricing notes — what you want shown (optional)
fields.placeholder: Service call: $89. Free estimates on remodels. Hourly: $95/hr after first hour. Flat-rate book on common repairs. Senior discount 10%.

steps.title: What's your team look like?
steps.description: For solos: license, insurance, manufacturer certifications, years on the tools. For multi-crew shops: crew count, trucks, and the credentials of the team. Becomes credibility on the site.

fields.name: trucks_crews
fields.label: Trucks / crews on the road
fields.placeholder: 1 truck or 2 crews + 3 trucks

fields.name: equipment_notes
fields.label: Notable certifications, license #s, manufacturer training, BBB rating
fields.placeholder: Master plumber license #CO-12345, NATE-certified HVAC, EPA 608, lead-safe certified, BBB A+ rating, Carrier Factory Authorized Dealer, anything you'd put on the truck.

steps.title: Why do customers pick you?
steps.description: Three or four short reasons. Bullet points, fragments, plain talk — exactly how you'd explain the fit on a phone call with a homeowner.

fields.name: reasons
fields.label: Reasons customers pick you
fields.placeholder:
Same tech every visit — no rotating crew.
Upfront, flat-rate pricing — no surprises.
Response to estimate requests within one business day.
Fifteen years of focused experience in [your trade].

steps.title: Got any numbers worth highlighting?
steps.description: Stats become credibility blocks on the site. Years on the tools, jobs completed, response time, certifications, anything quantifiable.

fields.name: stats
fields.label: Numbers and credentials
fields.placeholder:
12+ years on the tools.
4,000+ jobs completed.
24-hour estimate response.
Licensed in 3 counties.
NATE-certified, EPA 608, BBB A+.

steps.title: Any reviews you can share?
steps.description: Google reviews, BBB, Angi, HomeAdvisor, or Houzz quotes work great. We can pull live or curate the best. Skip if unsure — we'll start with placeholders and confirm what's appropriate on the call.

fields.name: testimonials
fields.label: Customer reviews (Google, BBB, Angi, Houzz, repeat customers)
fields.placeholder:
"Showed up on time, fixed the leak, didn't try to upsell. We'll call them every time." — Sarah K., Denver (Google review)
"Honest pricing, clean work, and they answered the phone on a Sunday." — Tom B., Lakewood (Google review)

steps.title: How do customers reach you?
steps.description: The contact info that goes on the site, and where new estimate requests should land.

fields.label: Business email (where estimate requests go)
fields.placeholder: estimates@yourbusiness.com

options.label: Phone calls
options.description: Live answer or voicemail with quick callback.

options.label: Email

options.description: Estimate-request form on the site.

fields.name: hours_response
fields.label: Business hours & typical reply time
fields.placeholder: Mon–Fri 7am–5pm. Saturday emergencies only. Most estimate requests returned within one business day.

steps.title: Brand colors.
steps.description: Your visual starting point. Drop in a primary and (optional) secondary color. We'll handle the logo separately on its own dedicated upload form.

fields.name: primary_color
fields.label: Primary color
fields.placeholder: Truck red, #c8312f, or 'match what we already have'

fields.name: secondary_color
fields.label: Secondary color
fields.placeholder: Charcoal, #2a2a2a, or leave blank

steps.title: Anything else we should know?
steps.description: Free-form. Trades you don't take, jobs you avoid, license numbers, lead-time policy, anything off-script.

fields.name: notes
fields.label: Open notes
fields.placeholder: We don't do roofing or hot tubs. Booked out two weeks on remodels; same-week on service calls. License #CO-MP-12345.

steps.title: Pick a plan that fits.
steps.description: Two site styles, three feature tiers each. Pick what looks closest — we'll confirm the right call on the follow-up. Yearly billing is shown (30% off the launch price).

extras.description: One-off build — see the pricing page for current options. You own the files; ongoing hosting and care optional.

extras.label: Not Sure Yet
extras.description: Walk through it together on the follow-up call. No commitment until you're sure.
